name: Gibtelecom Data Centre / Rockolo Mount Pleasant
notes: Gibtelecom owns and operates a data centre at Mount Pleasant (25 South Barrack Road) hosting third-party servers; GRA annual reports and 2025 Privy Council case summary (GibFibre v GRA) confirm the Mount Pleasant facility; GibFibre has pursued access to it through GRA/Supreme Court/Court of Appeal proceedings. Tier III per DataMove/industry listings; capacity not publicly disclosed.

name: Rockolo World Trade Center Data Centre
notes: Rockolo (Gibtelecom) opened a second Gibraltar facility in the World Trade Center (Feb 2017); DCD reported Mount Pleasant and WTC together provided ~17,200 sq ft of data centre space; GibFibre legal filings also name the WTC data centre. Round-one verified lead re-checked.

name: Continent 8 Gibraltar Data Centre (inside the Rock / COMCEN, Admiralty Tunnel)
notes: Operational secure hosting facility ~500 m inside the Rock of Gibraltar at the historic COMCEN/Admiralty Tunnel site; HMGoG minister visit (2024) and Continent 8 official Gibraltar location confirm; hosts gaming companies and the Government of Gibraltar under five-year hosting contract (Jun 2022-Jun 2027, awarded Sep 2022).

name: Pelagos Data Centres Gibraltar (near Port of Gibraltar)
notes: 250 MW total is announced/planned capacity across five phases (up to 250 MW by 2033, potential beyond 1 GW per LinkedIn coverage); ~GBP1.8bn project on ~20,000 sq m site near Port of Gibraltar (Neil Pinero Rd per Data Center Map). Ground-breaking reported Sep 2025 (World Construction Network) - status now construction; first phase targeted operational late 2027, later phases every 18 months. Tier III design, carrier-neutral, PUE <=1.2, renewable + LNG, independent of existing grid. Existence/plan = A (HMGoG announcement); construction-start claim = B (trade press).

name: GibFibre Data Centre (New Harbours)
notes: Purpose-built Tier III data centre at New Harbours Industrial Estate (GX11 1AA), opened Jul 2024; N+1 cooling, 2N UPS/generator, ISO 27001 and cleanroom certifications; DCD reports 30 racks across two contained hot aisles with 2.5/5 kW rack options; 400Gb resilient backbone with PoPs in Gibraltar, Madrid, Amsterdam, London. GibFibre is a private/authorised operator, not a government wholesale-fibre body.

name: Sapphire Europort (Sapphire Networks)
notes: Colocation/data centre service at Eurotowers, 3 Europort Road / Europort Avenue; Data Center Map describes chilled water-cooled colocation with up to 4 kW per rack; secondary coverage lists Sapphire as data centre services provider at Europort. Directory-grade lead - capacity/tier not operator-confirmed.
